meta.name: ai-social-media-content
meta.description: Create AI-powered social media content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter/X. Generate: images, videos, reels, shorts, thumbnails, captions, hashtags. Tools: FLUX, Veo, Seedance, Wan, Kokoro TTS, Claude for copywriting. Use for: content creators, social media managers, influencers, brands. Triggers: social media content, tiktok, instagram reels, youtube shorts, twitter post, content creator, ai influencer, social content, reels, shorts, viral content, thumbnail generator, caption generator, hashtag generator, ugc content

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成适配多平台的社交图文、视频和文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常为多平台做社交内容,想靠 AI 快速出图出视频
copy.tagline_en: Create social-ready images, videos, and captions for multiple platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly produce social content across platforms and want AI to speed up visuals and copy

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 infsh 调用 FLUX、Veo、Seedance 等模型,为 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Twitter/X 生成视频、图片、缩略图、字幕和标签,还能做多平台复用和批量生成。需先安装登录 infsh。
howto.when: 当你说出“TikTok”“Instagram Reels”“YouTube Shorts”等平台或“社交媒体内容”等关键词时触发;前提是已安装并登录 infsh CLI。

say.text: 帮我生成一条 TikTok 风格的 9:16 竖版视频,主题是晨间习惯
say.note: 会调用 Veo 模型生成视频。

say.text: 为这张日落照片写一段 Instagram 文案,带 10 个标签
say.note: 会调用 Claude-haiku 生成文案和标签。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the infsh CLI to call FLUX, Veo, Seedance, etc., generating videos, images, thumbnails, captions, and hashtags for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitter/X. Also handles multi-platform repurposing and batch creation. Requires infsh installed and logged in.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts, or ask for social media content, thumbnails, captions, or hashtags. Requires the infsh CLI installed and logged in.

say_en.text: Generate a TikTok-style 9:16 vertical video about a morning routine.
say_en.note: Calls Veo to create the video.

say_en.text: Write an Instagram caption with 10 hashtags for this sunset photo.
say_en.note: Uses Claude-haiku for copy and tags.

say_en.text: Repurpose 'productivity tips' into a TikTok vertical, Twitter square, and YouTube thumbnail.
say_en.note: Runs different models for each format.
